Hi Tara / Ken,

Thanks again for the demo last week — good to see the Greenline team running the ingestion and initial evals. You hit the token and latency patterns we expected for the pilot, but I noticed your team is running into the 14-day trial limit before you've completed the full E2E eval.

You asked on the call whether we can extend the trial and offer a small pool of one-time credits to cover the remaining validation work (a second round of eval prompts + a short smoke test with integrated tokens). I discussed internally and wanted to capture a formal request so I can route it for approval.

Ask: 30-day trial extension + $30k in one-time platform credits applied to your Greenline account (covering token usage and embeddings).
Why: The extension will let you run the new clinical prompt set and end-to-end privacy checks; the credits ensure we don't interrupt the evaluation while your procurement syncs.
Impact: We expect this will validate model quality and accelerate a POC-to-purchase conversation; if it looks good, Greenline intends to convert to a Dedicated seat (in-region) within Q3.

I've attached a usage snapshot and a short proposed terms doc for the credit application (non-binding). Please confirm the scope and any legal/contract constraints we should be aware of. If you want to loop in legal now I'll include them on the thread.

Thanks,
Dylan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
